description: This PHP source file defines a data access object (DAO) class EmployeeEventDao for managing EmployeeEvent entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving employee events and retrieving them with filtering and pagination support.

classes.name: EmployeeEventDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for EmployeeEvent entities, providing methods to save and retrieve events with filtering options.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Persists a new EmployeeEvent entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmployeeEvent entities based on search filters, returning results as an array.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and configures a Paginator object with query filters for retrieving EmployeeEvent entities based on search parameters.
